sources.title: Sealion 7 Australian handbook — controls and operating limits
sources.supports: 2025 handbook: pp. 46–48 digital keys; 60–61 seat memory/climate; 81 charging flap; 87–88 departure preparation and V2L; 104 starting; 112 adaptive cruise; 151–152 updates, voice and contacts. Later software can differ.

sources.title: Sealion 7 ANCAP — all-variant applicability and assessment scores
sources.supports: 2025 rating covers all variants built from January 2025. Adult 87%, child 93%, vulnerable road user 76%, safety assist 78%; expiry December 2031.

sources.title: BYD Australian 2026 warranty booklet
sources.supports: Pages 7–8: 6 years/150,000 km vehicle coverage; 8 years/160,000 km power battery and drive unit; 70% battery retention. Exclusions and original purchase terms apply.

sources.title: BYD Australia — service intervals
sources.supports: Published BEV interval of 12 months/20,000 km. Check the applicable vehicle maintenance schedule and quoted service prices.

sources.title: Model Y Australian manual — driver profiles
sources.supports: Up to 10 local profiles; supported settings, key association and limitations on cloud synchronisation.

sources.title: Model Y Australian manual — Auto Shift
sources.supports: Beta feature is off by default and varies by build/software; enable in Dynamics, meet operating conditions and confirm the selected direction.

sources.title: Model Y Australian manual — traffic-light chime
sources.supports: Enable Traffic Light Chime in Self-Driving settings. The lead-car movement chime is conditional on the driving-assistance state.

sources.title: Model Y Australian manual — media playback
sources.supports: Documents resuming previous media after browser audio and streaming connectivity requirements; does not establish universal playback on entry.

sources.title: Tesla Australia — referral eligibility
sources.supports: Public eligibility lists Model 3 for buyer/loyalty benefits, Model 3 and Model Y for referrer benefits. No fixed AUD award published in the checked page; apply referral before ordering.

sources.title: Tesla Australia — Supercharging other EVs
sources.supports: Selected sites accept compatible CCS vehicles; Tesla app 4.2.3+, site-specific rates, optional membership, stall selection and cable-reach limitations.

sources.title: Zeekr 7X Australian brochure — three-trim equipment matrix
sources.supports: Specification table visually checked: RWD, Long Range RWD and Performance AWD; 3.3 kW V2L, power charging cover, front seat memory, folding mirrors and phone projection. Black Special Edition is outside this matrix.

sources.title: Sealion 7 Australian 2026 specification — connectivity requirements
sources.supports: Current brochure footnotes confirm supported-device checks for digital keys; wireless Android Auto requires a data plan, 5 GHz Wi-Fi support and current software. Lists 11 kW AC and 150 kW DC. No current buttonless-start workflow is supplied.

features.value: 3.3 kW V2L · at least 15% charge to start
features.conditions: A compatible local-standard discharge adapter is required. The 15% figure is the handbook’s starting threshold, not a documented user-adjustable cutoff.
usability_notes: Total connected load must stay within 3.3 kW. A 2 kW appliance uses about 2 kWh per hour before conversion losses (calculation).
External appliance power; this does not establish grid export or whole-home backup.

features.value: NFC tap key; Bluetooth app key where enabled
features.conditions: Use the supported-phone list in the BYD app or Vehicle Settings → Digital Key. A supported brand alone does not establish handset compatibility.
